project_info.theme: Galaxy S25 Ultra processor performance poster

main_subject.detail: Black-background performance infographic showing a horizontal Galaxy S25 Ultra with a cinematic medieval game scene on the display, paired with CPU, GPU, and NPU improvement metrics and Snapdragon branding.

composition_elements.text: The most powerful processor customised for Galaxy / Galaxy S25 Ultra / Galaxy AI / CPU 37% Faster processing / GPU 30% Improved graphics performance / NPU 40% Faster AI performance / Powered by Snapdragon / Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy
items: Top Left: Large centered white title 'The most powerful processor customised for Galaxy'.
Top Right: Centered subheading 'Galaxy S25 Ultra' and 'Galaxy AI'.
Bottom Left: Blue metric '37%' above 'Faster processing' labeled CPU.
Bottom Right: Blue metric '40%' above 'Faster AI performance' labeled NPU, plus Snapdragon badge in the lower-right corner.

Center/Background: Horizontal Galaxy S25 Ultra showing a dramatic medieval battle game with a kneeling armored knight, ruined stone arch, smoke, castle, and fire; the mid-bottom also includes 'GPU 30% Improved graphics performance'; a white legal footnote spans the lower left edge.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp metallic frame highlights, cinematic screen glow, strong premium contrast against black
